description: A simple knife, you can dash (sprint 2 blocks) or backdash (back 2 blocks)
body:
# ⚔️ Knife Datapack

The Knife Datapack adds a brand-new custom weapon to Minecraft: a fast and deadly knife that doesn’t just deal damage – it lets you dash across the battlefield with style. Designed for both survival and PvP, this datapack makes movement and combat feel much more dynamic.

## ✨ Features

🪓 Custom Weapon: A knife with its own texture and 3D model.

⚡ Dash Ability: Right-click to dash forward.

🌀 Backdash: Quickly evade enemies or reposition yourself.

🔊 Custom Sound: Unique audio effect when using the ability.

⏳ Recharge Mechanic: Balanced cooldown system to avoid spamming.

💡 100% datapack – no mods required.

## 🛠️ How to Get the Knife

To craft the knife, simply drop 2 iron ingots and 1 stick under you.
The datapack will detect the items and reward you with your brand-new Knife.

## 🎮 How to Use

- Hold the Knife in your main hand.

- Right-click to perform a dash forward.

- Drop to use the backdash ability to dodge attacks.

- Wait for the cooldown before using it again.

## Perfect for:

- PvP players who want faster combat.

- Survival adventurers looking for mobility.

- Parkour or speedrunning challenges.


## HOW TO INSTALL
**to install the datapack, put the downloaded zip in the datapacks folders of your world and in the resourcepack folder**
